beats.story: The drive in to work with Cliff the following morning feels like it could be another skit from that HR video about how to be friendly with colleagues. Cliff begins with some light conversation about wildfire smoke starting earlier than usual this year, although he doesn't remember previous years. Then we pass a shuttered storefront, and he gets sad about the record shop he liked closing forever. I ask him when the last time he went was, and he realizes it's been two years. Then we both get quiet for a bit -- all fairly nice. And by the time we arrive downtown, my angst over his prior meeting with Caitlin has withered. Only to return when I swipe into the office and head to my desk. Armin's workstation is empty, while Rhonda sits staring at her screen, joylessly dipping a tea bag in a steaming cup.

You did me a pretty big solid last night when you didn't have to.
beats.story_cn: 我理当为她高兴。我凝聚全部意志力迫使嘴角上扬。要显得无比欣喜。正用袖口擦拭第三滴、也是最后一滴泪时，我瞥见阿明注视的目光。他迅速移开视线，在我来得及找话掩饰前已转向屏幕。片刻后消息弹出。阿明：嘿，我在想。昨晚你本不必帮忙，却为我扛下了不小的麻烦。

I really appreciate that. ARMIN: Of course. How could I forget: this job is all I have. And if there's still a chance to save it, I need to give it everything.

beats.story: So I spend the lunch hour working on a plan for the conference tomorrow. Because if I can just speak, I could beat her. I have enough information sitting on my lap in these emails. I could come up with something even better if I dig through it all. When Caitlin returns from her celebratory lunch with Marla, Garret, and Joy, I don't look up. I'll need the whole afternoon to pull something together this quickly. Maybe the whole night. I don't pay much attention when Rhonda sends Gregory a complaint that Caitlin and Armin are on their phones too much this afternoon.
beats.story_cn: 于是我利用午休时间赶制明天会议的演讲方案——只要轮到我发言，就能压过她一头。膝盖上这些邮件已塞满足够情报，若深挖细究，定能提炼出更精彩的策略。当凯特琳与玛拉、加雷特、乔伊庆祝午餐归来时，我头也没抬。要快速拼出方案，整个下午都得扑进去，或许熬通宵也未可知。朗达向格里高利投诉凯特琳和阿尔敏下午过度玩手机时，我根本没分神去听。

beats.story: Or note that my own phone sits silent as a paperweight. Cliff drives me home again, but I mostly just hum in agreement as he speaks, because my mind is flooding with all the information I've consumed. As soon as I get inside my apartment, I pull out my laptop and continue to prepare the presentation. I even figure out how to use a custom template to make it look nice. I read it over and over to check the spelling. Then I practice speaking in front of the mirror like I have nothing better to do. When I'm too tired to function anymore, I drop onto my bed and watch comedy skits on my phone. And I laugh without actually laughing.
beats.story_cn: 或许该瞥眼自己桌上如镇纸般沉默的手机。克里夫再次载我回家，但他说话时我只是含糊应和，思绪已如海啸般席卷过所有消化的信息。刚进公寓门就掏出笔记本继续打磨演讲稿，甚至琢磨出自定义模板让视觉效果更专业。反复通读检查拼写，接着对镜练习演说，仿佛别无要事可做。直到筋疲力尽时才瘫倒在床上刷喜剧短片，无声地笑着。
